subject: mathematics
content:
The intersection of the spheres
$${x^2} + {y^2} + {z^2} + 7x - 2y - z = 13$$ and
$${x^2} + {y^2} + {z^2} - 3x + 3y + 4z = 8$$
is the same as the intersection of one of the sphere and the plane
